title: Adjustment criteria
description: How one model attaches to the structure and how far a player may change it. Lengths are in model units: the model's longer side is 1, the anchor is the origin, +x is right, +y is up and +z faces the viewer. Angles are in degrees.

id.description: Name of the model, unique within its asset set.

kind.description: The kind of thing, as named in source.toml.

role.description: pinned: a solid thing held on with a pin. printed: a flat motif that follows the surface.

model.description: File name of the GLB model, beside this file.

natural.description: The model's longer side as a fraction of the structure's longer side, measured in the source image. A scale of 1 shows the model at this size.

thickness.description: How far the model rises above its anchor plane.

mode.description: pin: a pin through the anchor holds the model above the surface. print: the model lies in the surface.

anchor.description: The point on the model that meets the surface.

standoff.description: Distance between the surface and the anchor, along the surface normal.

visible.description: Whether a pin head shows at the anchor.

tilt.description: Lean away from the surface normal.

conform.description: How closely the model follows the surface under it. 0 keeps the model rigid. 1 wraps it onto the surface.

enabled.description: Whether the player may bend the model along a curve.

curve.description: The curve the model's long axis follows when bent.

max.description: How far a control point may move off the straight long axis.

mirror.description: Whether the player may flip the model left to right.

source.description: Where in the source image the model came from.

instance.description: The catalog instance the model was made from.

box.description: Left, top, right and bottom of the instance in source image pixels.

angle.description: Angle of the instance's long axis in the source image, counterclockwise from horizontal.

lift.description: How the model was made from its cutout.

backend.description: The lifting backend that made the model.

models.description: The machine learning models the backend ran.
